name: What is the process for installing new exterior window trim?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing new exterior window trim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process typically begins with an assessment of existing trim and window conditions. We then prepare the area, which may include removing old trim and cleaning the surfaces. New trim pieces are precisely measured, cut, and fastened securely around the window frame. Proper sealing and caulking are applied to ensure a watertight barrier against the elements. Finally, any necessary finishing touches like painting or touch-ups are completed. We ensure every step adheres to best practices for durability and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves assessing, preparing the area, precisely measuring and installing new trim, then sealing and finishing it. We focus on durability and aesthetics.
